common.protocol: Continue the 75.2083% high-alpha best. Same ten categories, original 120-product evaluation gallery and 480 test queries. No test/val training, no teacher. Control uses the 922-product pool; wide/views use the separately audited cap250 pool. Same 24x128 primary steps; views adds one training-only alternate-view forward, so training FLOPs differ. Same single-image inference and optical geometry.

domain_refine_pool500_mix13.protocol: Continue verified 76.25% best; cap500 pool, original/external products 1:3 in each category. Combined data+sampling intervention, not an isolated causal ablation. 24 epochs, minimum167 steps to visit every external product; no teacher. Original480 query/120 product gallery, optical geometry, Top2 and alpha>0.4 unchanged.
